sources.title: Open Food Facts: products sold in India (cleaned CSV snapshot)

retrieved_via.name: GitHub repository mvark/indiafoodstats (a volunteer's cleaned export of the OFF India database)
retrieved_via.why_this_route: The build sandbox's network policy blocks openfoodfacts.org, data.gov.in and Kaggle. GitHub raw is reachable, so this republished export was used. Run scripts/data/fetch_sources.py on a machine with open internet to pin a newer snapshot.

field_notes.code: Barcode (EAN/UPC) as typed by OFF contributors. Not all are valid.
field_notes.product_name: Serialised list of {lang, text}; many rows are blank.
field_notes.brands: Comma-separated, contributor-typed; casing and accents vary.
field_notes.categories: Free text, partly English tags; blank for more than half of the rows.
field_notes.quantity: Contributor-typed pack size ('250g', '1 l', '6 x 50 g'); blank for most rows.
field_notes.nova_group / nutriscore_grade: OFF-computed where inputs exist; kept for reference only.
field_notes.creator / last_modified_t: OFF contributor id and Unix time of last edit.

limitations: Crowdsourced: names, brands and pack sizes can be wrong or out of date.
Contains NO prices, stock, sales or shop-level data of any kind.
Over-represents packaged and branded food; loose staples (dal, rice, vegetables) are largely absent.
More than half of the rows lack a category or a usable pack size and are dropped by build_catalog.py.
No Gujarati or Hindi product names; those are never invented by this pipeline.
Popular products are not identifiable: the file has no scan counts, so selection is by completeness, not popularity.
